note: Published token-volume figures, one series per provider, each in its own unit (see unit). perDayT converts every point to trillion tokens per day (month = 30.4375 days) so series can share a log axis. date = the period the figure refers to when stated (month-only figures use the 1st), otherwise the announcement date; see each note. Figures are 'over/about' values as announced, not audited. Scopes differ (Google all products vs API; China is a national total), so compare growth, not levels.
